# Ben Harvey — benharveyai.com

> benharveyai.com is the engineering portfolio of Ben Harvey (Benjamin Harvey), an American senior
> software engineer. He ships AI-powered consumer apps on the Apple App Store.

## About

- Studied computer science at Towson (2011–2014).
- Senior Android Engineer at Meta, 2022–2025, working on Instagram: Kotlin + Jetpack Compose
  migration, crash detection and analysis tooling.
- Earlier: Walt Disney Studios, Beachbody, Wag Labs, TigerConnect.
- Now: building AI developer tooling and AI-powered consumer apps.

## Apps

- Fitness IQ — AI fitness coach for iPhone + Apple Watch: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6782227428
- Money IQ — AI money coach: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6787509698
